item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; cases=[({'declared':['b','a','a','skip'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','name':'same','hash':'1'},'b':{'kind':'file','timestamp':1},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'old'}},'current':{'a':{'kind':'file','name':'same','hash':'2'},'b':{'kind':'file','timestamp':2},'skip':{'kind':'file','hash':'y'},'extra':{'kind':'file','hash':'new'}}},{'ignored':['skip']},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a','b']}),({'declared':['x','y'],'saved':{},'current':{'x':{'kind':'missing'} }},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})];\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n rb,pb=copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol); got=evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert req==rb and pol==pb\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]; print('ok',report)\"]}"}
